caption: The drawing depicts a single, gold-colored candlestick centered on a plain, off-white background. The candlestick has a round, slightly flared base with a beveled edge, an elongated and faceted stem with several moldings, and a cup at the top designed to hold a candle. The object is rendered in shades of yellow and brown to give a metallic appearance, with shading used to indicate its three-dimensional form and reflective surface. There is a small handwritten label in black ink near the lower right area that reads "Harry Mason Wandsell." The background is unadorned, emphasizing the candlestick as the central subject.
title: Brass Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
